## A reproducible calculation {#sec-calculation}

This source executes in a fresh Python kernel. Cells read artifacts with
`cairn.use("runs/training")`, which names the latest `training` artifact in the
`runs` namespace, or search with `cairn.find("runs/*")`; the manifest records the
exact version of every artifact the report used.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-squares
#| tbl-cap: Squares of the first four integers
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
rows = "\n".join(f"| {n} | {n * n} |" for n in range(1, 5))
display(Markdown("| n | n² |\n| - | - |\n" + rows))
```

@tbl-squares follows the relationship $y = x^2$.[^execution]

$$y = x^2$$ {#eq-square}
